title: Horten flying wing with exposed frame and cockpit canopy (Fig. 3)
description: Photograph, printed sideways on the page, of a Horten flying wing aircraft on a runway, viewed from the front quarter, showing the cockpit canopy, engine intakes and partly exposed tubular framework near the nose. Captioned "Fig. 3". From the USAF report's discussion of the Horten Wing as the closest match to the estimated configuration of flying disks.
